scriptEn.hook: Three more stories shaping your world.

stories.headline: One year after Air India crash, families still wait for answers
stories.summary: A year ago, an Air India Boeing 787 crashed seconds after takeoff in Ahmedabad, killing 260 people. Families hoped for a final report this week, but investigators released only an interim one. Pilot groups are demanding clearer answers about why it happened.

keyword.definitionEn: an official effort to find out the truth about something

stories.hookText: ONE YEAR ON, STILL NO ANSWERS
stories.commentQuestion: Should crash investigations have a strict deadline for answers?

stories.headline: Study finds the strength-training sweet spot for a longer life
stories.summary: A study following more than 147,000 people for 30 years found a sweet spot for strength training. Just 90 to 120 minutes a week was linked to a 13 percent lower risk of death. Doing more than that added little extra benefit.

keyword.definitionEn: long life; living for many healthy years

stories.hookText: 2 HOURS A WEEK MAY ADD YEARS
stories.commentQuestion: How many minutes do you train each week?

stories.headline: Stanford scientists regrow knee cartilage and reverse arthritis in mice
stories.summary: Stanford scientists restored lost knee cartilage in older mice by blocking a single aging-related protein. Human tissue from knee surgeries also grew new cartilage. If it works in people, a simple injection or pill could one day replace many knee and hip replacements.

keyword.definitionEn: the strong, flexible tissue that cushions your joints

stories.commentQuestion: Would you take a pill instead of knee surgery?

todaysWord.definitionEn: long life; living for many healthy years
todaysWord.definitionJp: 長寿（長く健康に生きること）

scriptEn.close: That's your world in sixty. Follow for tomorrow.

stories.headline: エア・インディア墜落から1年、遺族はなお答えを待つ
stories.summary: 1年前、アーメダバードでエア・インディアのボーイング787が離陸直後に墜落し、260人が死亡した。遺族は今週の最終報告を期待したが、出たのは中間報告のみ。パイロット団体は原因の明確な説明を求めている。

stories.headline: 筋トレの最適量、研究が示す「長生きの目安」
stories.summary: 14万7千人を30年追った研究で、筋トレの最適量が見えた。週90〜120分の筋トレは、あらゆる死因のリスクを13%下げることと関連していた。それ以上やっても追加の効果はほとんどなかった。

stories.headline: スタンフォード、膝軟骨の再生に成功（マウス）
stories.summary: スタンフォードの研究者が、老化に関わるタンパク質を阻害し、高齢マウスの失われた膝軟骨を再生させた。膝手術で採取したヒト組織でも新たな軟骨が育った。実用化すれば、注射や飲み薬が膝・股関節の置換手術に代わる可能性がある。
